📋 Workflow: Job Finder - Remote Cloud Discovery
🎯 Purpose: Discover new remote cloud/DevOps entry-level roles, filter for keywords, deduplicate, and notify via WhatsApp + Gmail
⏰ Schedule: Every 6 hours
📡 Sources: Remotive, RemoteOK, Arbeitnow APIs
💾 Dedup: n8n Data Table 'remote_job_finder_seen_jobs'
📲 Notify: WhatsApp (Twilio Sandbox) + Gmail digest
🔧 Env Vars: N8N_USER_WHATSAPP_NUMBER, N8N_USER_EMAIL
